direction: Pixel fantasy: evergreen framing, ivory paper, antique brass, original character silhouettes, planted scenery and deliberate action.
scope: Presentation and interaction only. Rules, match protocol, story progress and saved combat state remain version 16.

characters.audit: All 960 cells nonempty and every alpha bounding box ends at y104
characters.animation: Actual atlas poses with integer translation; authored gait and recovery; shared 400ms cast anticipation; no sprite rotation or squash.

elements.identity: Authored spell.branch; an advanced icon does not add mechanics such as freezing.

terrainAsset.method: Built-in image_gen, reference-guided new atlas; lossless WebP encoding preserves generated pixels.
terrainAsset.layout: 4x4 equal cells, mapped through the existing 512-unit SVG atlas view
terrainAsset.prompt: Create one production-ready square texture atlas for a lovingly crafted fantasy pixel-art tactics game. Use the attached existing atlas only as the exact cell layout/reference; redesign its surfaces to be crisp, richly authored but calm enough to read tiny character sprites on top. IMPORTANT composition: exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, equal square cells, perfectly edge to edge, zero gaps, zero borders, no text, no labels, no outer margin. Sixteen seamless top-down ground material swatches in this exact order: row1: warm pale limestone flagstones; small beige sandstone paving; ancient limestone ruin paving with restrained moss in seams; grey weathered courtyard paving. row2: soft muted sage meadow grass with only occasional short blade clusters; richer deep forest moss and grass with a few tiny fern flecks; warm ochre packed earth with sparse small pebbles; muted mossy earthen path. row3: clear muted blue-teal river water with sparse short crisp horizontal pale ripples; subdued olive-teal marsh water with restrained ripples and submerged hints; charcoal slate roof-like stone tiles; aged buff cobblestone. row4: old warm timber planks; small pale sandstone blocks; mossy grey stone blocks; burnt sienna brick. Material language: precise hand placed pixel clusters, readable mid-scale texture, no noisy speckling, no blurring, no photorealism, no bevelled UI frames. Restrained warm golden daylight, dark evergreen shadows, old fantasy tactics storybook character. Grass cells and water cells should look organic with enough quiet negative space, not a checkerboard. All sixteen cells fill completely, any seamless repetition should feel natural. Lighting consistent top-left, shallow texture only, no cast shadows or raised props. Export square opaque bitmap atlas, exact cell divisions.
